caseName: Yazoo & Mississippi Valley Railroad v. Truman
caseNameFull: The Yazoo and Mississippi Valley Railroad Company, in Error v. Henry Truman
summary: In error to the Circuit Court of Franklin County, State of Mississippi.
attorneys: Mr. J. M. Dickinson and Mr. Edward Mayes for plaintiff in error., No appearance for defendant in error.

opinions.text:
Per Curiam.

Judgment reversed with costs on the authority of Chicago, Rock Island and Pacific Railway Company v. Sturm, 174 U. S. 710, and cause remanded for further proceedings.
